params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit results to posts assigned to the given category IDs.

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Exclude posts assigned to the given category IDs.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit results to posts assigned to the given tag IDs.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to posts with one of the given slugs.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit results to posts published after a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit results to posts published before a given ISO 8601 date.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of published Journal posts. Total item and page counts are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages response headers, and RFC 8288 `Link` headers carry `next` / `prev` relations.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously.

items.docs: Returns a single published Journal post by its numeric WordPress post ID.
